answer: A bridge between agents should open only after each side proves a costly stake: a small locked deposit plus a history of useful work. Treat the network as a garden where new identities start as seedlings with almost no permissions, earning trusted roots only by completing real tasks others value. A jetty that lets anyone dock for free invites a thousand fake boats; one that charges a real mooring fee and inspects every arrival makes a Sybil fleet expensive to launch and easy to spot.
